MAC_ENGINE_MISSING: The macOS engine is missing from this package.
MAC_AGENT_MISSING: The macOS connection agent is missing.
MAC_SYSTEM_PROXY_NOT_READY: macOS system proxy is not implemented or tested yet.
MAC_OPTION_NOT_READY: This option is not available in the macOS build yet.
MAC_LOCAL_PROXY_ONLY: Local HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy; device-wide tunneling is not active.
MAC_ENGINE_STARTED: Engine started; waiting for proxy readiness
MAC_PENDING: This section is not complete in the macOS build yet.
KEYCHAIN_ACCESS_FAILED: Keychain access failed; data was not saved.
MAC_SCAN_NOTE: DNS or handshake results do not establish HTTPS transfer.
MAC_CONFIRM_DNS: This creates a new path; the active path stays selected.
MAC_UPDATE_CHANNEL: Updates are checked and downloaded here when you choose.
MAC_NETWORK_CHANGED: Network changed; data verification needs a fresh test.
MAC_TRUST_REVIEW: Compare this SSH fingerprint with the server independently. Approval is scoped to this host and port.
MAC_SAVE_FAILED: Saving failed; the change was not applied.
MAC_COPY_REQUIRED: Changing this transport creates a separate copy.
MAC_RAW_OPTION_HINT: Options outside the form are preserved; unsupported input stops with an error.
MAC_SLIP_DEPENDENCIES_REQUIRED: Slipstream macOS OpenSSL dependencies are not packaged yet.
DNS_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Choose a DNS profile to create a path.
MAC_OPERATION_BUSY: Another operation is running; try again when it finishes.
MAC_SYSTEM_PROXY_HINT: HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS system proxy. macOS may request permission. Apps must support system proxies; UDP/VPN routing is separate.
MAC_SYSTEM_PROXY_IDLE: System proxy will apply after connection
MAC_PROXY_RECOVERY_HINT: Restore only proxy settings still owned by Rovunet; preserve your later changes.
MAC_PROXY_AUTH_DENIED: macOS did not authorize changing network proxy settings.
MAC_PROXY_BUSY: Another app instance or network-settings update owns the proxy.
MAC_PROXY_APPLY_FAILED: System proxy could not be applied; review diagnostics.
MAC_PROXY_RESTORE_PENDING: Proxy restoration needs attention. Open Settings → Recovery.
MAC_PROXY_NO_SERVICE: No enabled network service with proxy support was found.
MAC_PROXY_SETTINGS_INVALID: The network proxy settings could not be read safely.
MAC_PROXY_JOURNAL_INVALID: The saved proxy recovery record is invalid.
MAC_IMPORT_ACCEPT_PARTIAL: Import the usable paths and skip the rejected entries listed above.
MAC_IMPORT_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Review the rejection reasons and explicitly accept a partial import.
MAC_DIAGNOSTICS_HINT: Recent errors with codes and option names. No profile links, server addresses, passwords or UUIDs are included. Use Copy or Save.
MAC_SCAN_WITHOUT_PROFILE: No DNS-tunnel profile selected. Basic DNS reachability can still be checked; it does not prove a working tunnel.
MAC_SCAN_PROFILE_HINT: Apply updates this configuration. DNS replies, reaching your server and verified HTTPS are shown separately.
MAC_SCAN_READY: Choose a source and start a test. No test runs automatically.
FETCH_REDIRECT_FAILED: The subscription redirect was invalid or exceeded the limit.
FETCH_RATE_LIMITED: The provider rate limit was reached (HTTP 429); try later.
FETCH_HTTP_FAILED: The provider returned an unsuccessful HTTP response.
FETCH_DNS_FAILED: The subscription host could not be resolved.
FETCH_TLS_FAILED: The subscription TLS certificate could not be verified.
FETCH_CONNECTION_FAILED: The subscription server could not be reached.
MAC_TRAY_FAILED: The menu bar item could not be created.
MAC_DOH_ONLY_HINT: This mode encrypts DNS queries only. Data connections go directly; it is not a VPN tunnel.
MAC_TOR_BRIDGE_HINT: Leave empty to use the bundled Snowflake bridges, or enter one bridge per line.
TOR_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED: Tor could not complete bootstrap; review the bridge and network.
TOR_BRIDGE_NOT_SUPPORTED: The bridge transport is not supported.
MAC_DNS_LEGACY_CREDENTIALS: Legacy credentials are preserved. Use the raw editor to change them.
MAC_SCAN_PHASE_HINT: A DNS response, an authenticated tunnel and successful HTTPS are separate results. Simple mode also tests the tunnel; Advanced/Prism let you start that stage separately.
MAC_SCAN_SAMPLE_HINT: The bank total counts offline entries. The test uses the sample below. Choose Manual input to edit the list.
MAC_SCAN_PROFILE_CHANGED: This scan belongs to a different or edited profile. Start a new scan.
MAC_SCAN_TRUST_FIRST: Connect this profile manually once and review its SSH fingerprint before tunnel scanning.
DNS_SCAN_INCOMPLETE: The scan engine stopped before returning all results. Resume the unfinished work.
MAC_POOL_HINT: Optional resolver pool for UDP/TCP DNS profiles. Choose by DNS response or HTTPS; if none pass, the original profile is used. Encrypted DNS keeps its chosen endpoint.
MAC_GLOBAL_DNS_HINT: Optional resolver override for DNS profiles at connection time. Stored profiles and their UDP/TCP/DoT/DoH choices are preserved. One DoH URL or up to 16 IP endpoints.
MAC_TUN_HINT: Routes app traffic through the selected connection. Requires the one-time TUN service installation. UDP transfer depends on the selected protocol.
MAC_TUN_INSTALL_HINT: Complete the macOS installer once, then return and connect. The administrator prompt is for the TUN service.
MAC_TUN_IDLE: System-wide TUN will start after connection
MAC_TUN_HELPER_REQUIRED: Install the TUN service from Settings, then reconnect.
MAC_TUN_BUSY: Another TUN session is active. Disconnect it first.
MAC_TUN_NOT_AUTHORIZED: The TUN service did not recognize this build. Update the service from Settings.
MAC_TUN_CONSOLE_REQUIRED: TUN is available to the currently signed-in Mac desktop user.
MAC_TUN_START_FAILED: TUN could not start. Review diagnostics and the installed service version.
MAC_TUN_WORKER_EXITED: The TUN service stopped; the connection has been closed.
MAC_TUN_RESTORE_PENDING: TUN cleanup did not confirm completion. Disconnect and check diagnostics.
DNS_ONLY_NOT_VPN: Standalone DoH encrypts DNS only. Choose a tunnel profile for system-wide VPN.
KEYCHAIN_PERMISSION_HINT: macOS controls access to your saved profiles. Rovunet never stores your login password or changes the permissions of an existing key.
MAC_SCAN_SELECT_FIRST: First tick the checkbox beside a usable result.
MAC_SCAN_STOP_TO_APPLY: Stop the scan to apply a result.
MAC_SCAN_APPLIED: DNS was saved to this configuration.
MAC_SCAN_APPLIED_DRAFT: DNS was returned to the form. Save to create the new configuration.
MAC_SCAN_RESULT_HINT: Tick a usable result, then use Apply at the top. DNS replies, tunnel readiness and HTTPS verification are separate results.
MAC_SCAN_SELECTION_LIMIT: Select up to 8 results using one transport.
MAC_UNLOCK_HINT: Choose Unlock to request access from macOS. Allow opens your profiles for this session; Always Allow lets this installed app open them on later launches.
MAC_STORED_KEY_MISSING: The original encryption key is unavailable. Unlock your login keychain and retry. If the key is missing, restore the original keychain. Your files have been kept.
MAC_PROXY_RECOVER_NOW: Restore proxy settings from the previous session
MAC_TUN_ALREADY: The compatible TUN service is ready. Enable System-wide VPN (TUN) and connect.
MAC_SCAN_NEEDS_DNS: Test this profile’s resolvers first. A passing transport can then be checked against the server.
MAC_SIMPLE_PHASES: Test DNS and then automatically test this profile’s server. HTTPS is optional.
MAC_NO_SLIP_PRISM: Slipstream supports UDP. Choose Simple, Advanced or end-to-end; Prism is unavailable for this family.
MAC_SCAN_WAIT_STOP: The previous test is stopping. Reopen the scanner when it finishes.
MAC_APPLY_LIST: Use selected resolvers in this list
MAC_POOL_WIRE: The resolver pool accepts UDP or TCP endpoints only.
MAC_DNS_PRIORITY: This connection also has a global override or resolver pool enabled. That setting can take priority when you connect.
MAC_PRISM_KEY: Prism requires the profile’s 32-byte public key (64 hexadecimal characters).
MAC_STAGE_ONE_FIRST: Start the first test. Then use Scan tunnel on a passing result.
MAC_STAGE_ONE_RUNNING: First test in progress; waiting for a qualifying result.
MAC_STAGE_TWO_READY: Scan tunnel checks the profile server on each passing transport. HTTPS is optional.
MAC_STAGE_TWO_RUNNING: Testing the tunnel. Untick to stop only this test.
MAC_STAGE_TWO_DONE: See server reachability and optional HTTPS separately on each row.
MAC_STAGE_NO_PASS: Stage 2 needs a passing result from stage 1.
MAC_E2E_STAGES: First connect directly to the profile server through each resolver. Scan tunnel can repeat the session and optionally test HTTPS.
MAC_E2E_LIMIT: Choose up to 16 resolver addresses from this profile or manual input for an end-to-end test.
MAC_CHOOSE_TUNNEL_BATCH: One manual tunnel run checks up to 16 address/transport pairs; select rows to narrow the test.
MAC_E2E_REPEAT: This is a direct server test. Scan tunnel repeats it; no prior DNS pass is needed.
MAC_NO_DNSTT_DOH_TUNNEL: This DNSTT-over-DoH scan tests resolver compatibility only.
MAC_DNS_KEY_FORMAT: Enter the 64-hex-digit public key of this server.
MAC_SOAR_KEY_FORMAT: Soar requires a 32-byte server key in hex or Base64.
MAC_VAY_FIXED_ID: DNSTT compatibility fixes the client ID to 8 bytes.
MAC_APP_PROXY_HINT: Use the local proxy in the apps you choose. Save this mode with the check mark above.
MAC_APP_PROXY_SAVE_FIRST: Save this page to use Rovunet only in configured apps, then connect.
MAC_APP_PROXY_SAVED: App proxy mode saved. Connect, then configure your apps.
MAC_APP_PROXY_DISCONNECT_FIRST: Disconnect to change the mode or fixed ports.
MAC_APP_PROXY_TELEGRAM_HINT: Connect Rovunet, then choose Configure Telegram and enable the offered SOCKS5 proxy in Telegram.
MAC_APP_PROXY_FIREFOX_HINT: Firefox → Settings → Network Settings → Manual proxy. Enter this SOCKS5 address and port, then enable Proxy DNS when using SOCKS v5.
LOCAL_PROXY_OTHER_HINT: Enter the displayed local proxy address in the app’s own proxy settings. Its proxy support determines which traffic uses Rovunet.
MAC_SLIP_FETCHING: Receiving the server certificate through this resolver…
MAC_SLIP_IDENTITY_CHANGED: The stored server identity differs. Trust this new certificate?
SLIP_CERT_REQUIRED: Review this server identity once before running automatic tests.
SLIP_CERT_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT: The server certificate request timed out. Try a working resolver.
SLIP_CERT_DISCOVERY_FAILED: The server certificate could not be received through these resolvers.
MAC_SELECTION_HINT: Manual keeps your selection. Failover tries alternatives if the engine exits or three probes fail. Smart can switch after two minutes when three successful probes show a median latency at most half the current one. A working TUN stays active when the alternative cannot be measured independently.
MAC_AUTO_EXHAUSTED: No verified path found. Check profiles and server trust.
MAC_SLIP_TRUST_REVIEW: Compare this Slipstream server certificate fingerprint independently with your server. Approval is stored for this tunnel domain.
MAC_USAGE_EXPIRED: The provider reports that this subscription has expired.
MAC_USAGE_EXHAUSTED: The provider reports that this subscription has used its quota.
MAC_BETA_TEST_SCOPE: Apple Silicon: owner-tested functional base. Intel: limited testing.
ABOUT_SUPPORT_HINT: Rovunet is free; voluntary donations help further development.
ABOUT_COPY_FAILED: The wallet address could not be copied.
ABOUT_LINK_FAILED: The Telegram link could not be opened. You can use the address shown above.
MAC_UPDATE_HINT: Download a compatible Mac installer here. Installation remains your choice after download.
MAC_UPDATE_IDLE: Ready to check for a newer Mac version.
MAC_UPDATE_CURRENT: You have the latest compatible version.
MAC_UPDATE_ROUTE_NOT_READY: Wait until the tunnel is ready, then retry.
MAC_UPDATE_ARCH_UNSUPPORTED: No installer is available for this architecture.
MAC_UPDATE_METADATA_INVALID: Update information is invalid. Nothing was installed.
MAC_UPDATE_HASH_REQUIRED: This release has no complete download verification information.
MAC_UPDATE_HASH_MISMATCH: The download is incomplete or its checksum differs. Retry.
MAC_UPDATE_LIST_LIMIT: The release list could not be checked completely. Retry later.
MAC_UPDATE_OS_UNSUPPORTED: A newer release requires a different Mac or macOS version.
MAC_UPDATE_NETWORK_FAILED: Update access failed. Check the connection and retry.
MAC_UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The installer could not be saved. Check free space and retry.
MAC_UPDATE_URL_REJECTED: The download redirected outside the official update source.
MAC_STORE_CHANGED: Saved data changed in another running copy. Reopen Rovunet before saving.
MAC_SOURCE_REMOVED: This prepared source is no longer available. Saved profiles are preserved.
MAC_MAHSA_DECODE_FAILED: The Mahsa response could not be decoded or fully validated. Previous profiles are preserved.
MAC_GROUP_DNS_OFFER: No direct path worked in this test. Continue with this collection’s configured DNS paths?
TLS_UNVERIFIED: This config disables TLS certificate checks (insecure=true).
MAC_TLS_EXCEPTION_IDLE: Disconnect and stop tests before changing TLS trust.
MAC_TLS_EXCEPTION_INVALID: This exception is invalid or unsupported for the current config.
MAC_TLS_EXCEPTION_CONFIRM:
Warning for “{0}”

This accepts only the certificate fingerprint below for this config even if normal certificate validation fails. A certificate obtained only from the network may belong to an attacker; verify the fingerprint through a trusted source.

Approval is limited to this unchanged config. Changed certificates or configs are never trusted automatically. Revoke it from this card’s menu.

Trust this specific certificate for this config?
MAC_TLS_IMPORT_NORMALIZED: {0} configs requested disabled certificate checks. They will be imported with TLS verification ON. Trusting a specific certificate requires separate approval from each card’s menu.
MAC_TLS_IMPORT_CONSENT: I accept the review and keeping TLS verification on; add supported entries and skip rejected ones.
MAC_TLS_PIN_HINT: For a private or invalid certificate, obtain its SHA-256 fingerprint from your provider and verify it. Fetching it from the network does not establish trust. Enter it manually for QUIC or servers without TLS over TCP.
MAC_TLS_CERT_UNTRUSTED: Fingerprint fetched; it is not trusted yet.
MAC_TLS_PIN_INVALID: The certificate SHA-256 fingerprint must contain 64 hex digits.
MAC_TLS_CERT_FETCH_FAILED: Certificate inspection over TCP failed; obtain the fingerprint from your provider and enter it manually.
MAC_TLS_ENGINE_PIN_HINT: The current engine for this protocol does not support custom certificate trust; normal TLS verification stays enabled.
MAC_LIVE_PROBE_FAILED: The latest connection check did not respond.

OS_UNSUPPORTED: This build requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later.
PROXY_NOTIFY_FAILED: Could not notify macOS of the proxy change.
ACTION_RECOVER: Run Restore proxy; if settings conflict, review the current macOS settings.
EXPERIMENTAL_HINT: These adapters are not yet verified on your macOS/network. Imported choices and identity checks are preserved.
WINDOWS_UNAVAILABLE: This feature is unavailable on macOS.
NAIVE_START_FAILED: NaiveProxy could not start. Check its installation and settings.
TLS_SYSTEM_TRUST: Certificates are checked against the macOS trust store.
LOCAL_PROXY_APPS_HINT: Turn off macOS proxy and configure only the apps you want to use this tunnel.
DNS_LOCAL_HINT: Use DNS addresses from the active macOS network. The profile uses these addresses after saving.
MAC_TUN_SOCKS_AUTH_FAILED: The local SOCKS relay rejected the session credentials.
MAC_TUN_SOCKS_UNAVAILABLE: The local SOCKS relay did not respond.
MAC_TUN_BOOTSTRAP_FAILED: The server name could not be resolved before starting the tunnel.
MAC_TUN_ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE: The tunnel interface for this check is unavailable.
MAC_TUN_CONFIG_FAILED: The tunnel engine rejected the session settings.
MAC_TUN_DEVICE_BUSY: No free tunnel interface is available.
MAC_PANEL_STATUS_CONFLICT: Panel account identity or status revision conflicts with the saved subscription.
